summary: NewGenIvf Group filed a 6-K reporting the September 30, 2026 closing of a best-efforts public offering placed by Aegis Capital as exclusive agent. The company issued 125,000 Class A ordinary shares plus pre-funded warrants for up to 17,732,143 Class A ordinary shares, raising roughly $1.25 million gross, with Aegis paid an 8.0% cash fee plus expense reimbursement. Proceeds fund K25.ai investment, debt restructuring, working capital, and Nodexus cell-sorting machine deployment. Officers, directors, and employees signed 60-day lock-ups. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
